subject: biology
method: Independent full question/solution reading, fresh numerical reconstruction, statement-level scope and complete SVG visual review. Author generator is not imported.
visualReview: Inspected all 50 final SVGs in five d-contact sheets. Explicitly rechecked revised 707 joined sister chromatids, 712 pedigree mating line, 718 separate biomass/oxygen panels, 727 cell-count labels, 733 near-wall incipient detachment, 740 rescaled marker load and 747 patch-column alignment.
resolvedFindings: D718: algae and dissolved oxygen now use distinct panels with their own units.
D727: DNA-content measurements consistently refer to cells rather than isolated nuclei containing mitotic cells.
D733: incipient plasmolysis now shows near-wall detachment rather than advanced contraction.
limitations: Independent AI review, not moderation by human IB examiners. Constructed practice evidence is not genuine published research.
